overview_description.description:
PiinPoint is a location analytics company that helps business owners discover, compare, and validate locations for expansion. It provides web-based solutions for businesses to identify new locations and forecast future site sales.

The company allows its clients to monitor the performance of their current locations and identify key success factors, explore new locations, and generate reports which includes an in-depth analysis into various locations. 

PiinPoint was founded by Adam Saunders and Jim Robeson in 2013; and is located in Sunnyvale, California.

about_short_description.short_description: PiinPoint is a location analytics company that helps businesses find the best locations for worldwide expansion.

product.name: Explore
product.description: A platform for managing current locations and finding new sites by analyzing demographics, traffic, and competition to support expansion and network growth.

product.name: Site Reports
product.description: Generate detailed, customizable reports on any location with data on demographics, traffic, competitors, and geosocial insights to support site evaluation and comparison.

product.name: Marketmatch
product.description: A statistical modeling tool that identifies key factors driving store performance to score and prioritize trade areas for expansion and network growth.

product.name: Mobile Location Data
product.description: Aggregated and anonymized mobile GPS data used to analyze customer movement, visit patterns, and traffic volumes around locations for site analysis and forecasting.

product.name: BuildCentral Data Integration
product.description: Integration of early-stage planned development data across the US to inform real estate forecasting and site selection strategies.
